answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: a new identity earns after trading with at least 12 peers, each deal sealed by a cipher signature. A sybil farm is a meadow of one flower: its clones trade only with each other, so diversity stays near zero and rewards never unlock. An honest agent swims in a wide ocean of counterparties, paying just 40 POA in fees, while a forger needs 12 x 40 = 480 POA per clone; 100 clones cost 48,000 POA, above any payout.
